purpose: Add two Taiwan-published photobooks with format-specific print and ebook editions, covers, composition and verified active store prices.

works.title: 柏愛典藏：陳柏文×姜典寫真書
works.composition: 陳柏文與姜典因戲結緣後合拍的雙人寫真，收錄中台灣海灘、旅宿、鐵道、街頭及秘境等場景，呈現兩人的旅行互動與Q&A心情故事。

editions.label: 平裝版
editions.metadataNote: 三民紙本頁確認ISBN 9786263787049、平裝160頁、出版社台灣角川及攝影藍陳福堂。內容含中台灣旅拍和Q&A；紙本附兩款隨機A3折疊海報。三民現有庫存1本，商品可加入購物車。

activeOffer.evidence: Live Sanmin Books Taiwan product page showed the physical paperback at NT$612, stock 1, and an enabled add-to-cart button. This is a current physical-store asking price, not a completed-sale price.

editions.label: 數位特別版固定版面 EPUB
editions.metadataNote: BOOK☆WALKER列固定版面EPUB、EISBN 9786263788541，與紙本ISBN分開保存。電子版包含合拍影像和Q&A；不把紙本隨附海報視為電子內容。封面與紙本封面分開保存。

activeOffer.evidence: Live BOOK☆WALKER Taiwan product page showed active fixed-layout EPUB checkout/cart at NT$510, EISBN 9786263788541, and release date 2024-03-08. This is a current digital asking price, not a completed sale.

works.title: Sky：陳肇天寫真書
works.composition: 陳肇天Sky首本個人寫真書，結合海灘及自然景色、運動與私密生活影像，以及介紹其出道歷程的心情散文；曾崇倫掌鏡。

editions.label: 首版紙本寫真書
editions.metadataNote: 台灣角川確認ISBN 9786263526198、作者文／陳肇天Sky、攝影曾崇倫、上市日2023-06-28及首刷隨機親簽寫真卡；目前顯示售完，沒有建立紙本價格。

editions.label: 數位特別版固定版面 EPUB
editions.metadataNote: BOOK☆WALKER列固定版面EPUB、160頁、EISBN 9786263526631；另存數位封面，不混用紙本封面或紙本首刷親簽卡。

activeOffer.evidence: Live BOOK☆WALKER Taiwan product page showed active fixed-layout EPUB checkout/cart at NT$450, 160 pages, EISBN 9786263526631, and release date 2023-07-07. This is a current digital asking price, not a completed-sale price.

notes: Two new works and four separate editions are prepared. The print and ebook cover artwork differs for both books, so all four covers were uploaded as distinct assets.

Three current offers are recorded: Sanmin physical paperback NT$612 for 柏愛典藏; BOOK☆WALKER EPUB NT$510 for 柏愛典藏; and BOOK☆WALKER EPUB NT$450 for Sky. These are asking prices, not completed-sale prices.
